name: dictation
description: Speak instead of typing: hands-free dictation controlled by the mouse wheel button, transcribed locally with faster-whisper in any language

ui.title: Interface language
ui.description: Language of the band, toasts and command output

language.title: Speech language
language.description: ISO code of the spoken language (pt, en, es, ...), or 'auto' to detect it on each segment

model.title: Model
model.description: faster-whisper model (bigger = more accurate, slower on CPU)

silence.title: Pause (s)
silence.description: Seconds of silence that close a segment while recording (never ends the dictation)

sendWords.title: Extra send words
sendWords.description: Comma-separated spoken words that send the text, added to the built-in ones (send, enviar, envoyer, senden, invia...)

cancelWords.title: Extra cancel words
cancelWords.description: Comma-separated spoken words that discard the text, added to the built-in ones (cancel, cancelar, annuler, abbrechen, annulla...)
